name: Juhayna Food Industries S.A.E.
source: Juhayna Food Industries S.A.E. CRON 2026-11-06: the H1 2026 column carried revenue and net profit only. Added from the issuer's own 1H26 earnings release dated 04 August 2026, which is the consolidated results announcement filed with the Egyptian Exchange: net revenue 17,678 million Egyptian pounds, gross profit 4,326 million at a 24.5 percent margin, EBITDA 2,674 million at 15.1 percent, net profit 1,382 million at 7.8 percent, selling general and administrative expenses 2,017 million at 11.4 percent of sales, finance costs approximately 573 million. Read 2026-11-06. Gross Profit is entered at the printed 4,326,000,000, rounded exactly as the issuer published it in millions, matching the millions precision the revenue cell already carries. Cost of Sales 13,352,000,000 is revenue less the printed gross profit, 17,678 less 4,326, and is tagged derived because the release prints the gross profit rather than a cost of sales line. Operating Expenses is the printed selling, general and administrative expense of 2,017,000,000. Operating Profit, Profit Before Tax and Income Tax are left empty: the release prints EBITDA, not EBIT, so depreciation and amortisation are not in hand and an operating profit cannot be stated without them, and it prints no tax line. An empty cell is the honest state here rather than a figure built on a guess. Source URL https://foudalens.com/disclosures/JUFO.CA/other/2026-08-05_292486_3.pdf | CRON 20261106: Juhayna Food Industries 1H 2026 earnings release, consolidated income statement, printed EGP absolute, from https://www.juhayna.com/app/uploads/2026/08/2Q26-Earnings-Release-ENG.pdf (page 7 of 11). Printed: net sales 17,677,935,871; cost of sales (13,352,163,540); gross profit 4,325,772,331; results from operating activities 2,339,005,633; losses from jointly controlled entities nil; net finance cost (573,161,276); net profit before income tax 1,765,844,357; current income tax (399,820,356); deferred tax 15,806,248; net profit after tax 1,381,830,249; basic earnings per share EGP 1.17 (1H25 0.66). Ties: 1,765,844,357 minus 384,014,108 net tax equals 1,381,830,249 exactly. Two stored cells were replaced because the source printed them differently: Operating Profit (EBIT) held 2,309,000,000 against the printed 2,339,005,633, and EPS held a computed 0.937624 (net profit divided by issued shares) against the printed 1.17. Income Tax is the net of the printed current charge and the deferred credit. | CRON 20261106: H1 2026 gross and operating margins computed from the same release's printed figures, gross profit 4,325,772,331 over net sales 17,677,935,871 = 24.47%, results from operating activities 2,339,005,633 over net sales = 13.23%; the stored prior-year columns use the same construction.
